issues.title: Formal statistical validity is not established
issues.evidence: The 23-family corrected release has 552 matched rows and a deterministic paired-family bootstrap/McNemar analysis. Pooled G4-minus-G3 accuracy difference is -0.01811594202898551 with family-bootstrap 95% CI [-0.07608695652173915, 0.043478260869565216] and exact matched McNemar p=0.6353076420876663. CF3 is a prespecified exploratory stratum with difference -0.2753623188405797 and exact p=0.0005461. The analysis remains pending independent statistical review and does not justify causal or superiority claims.
issues.remediation: Have an independent reviewer inspect the preregistration, oracle provenance, paired-family construction, and statistical code before any confirmatory inference.

issues.title: G6 A arm execution semantics do not match the G6/G7 protocol
issues.evidence: The G6 protocol defines G6_A_G3_GIVEN as the derived G3 Tools+Iteration arm. The frozen project runner scripts/run_g6_counterfactual.py instead gives G3 no tools, exactly two fixed-reflection model calls, and rejects G3 tool calls; docs/experiment_groups.md and configs/experiment_groups.json confirm the same implementation. The existing 552-row corrected subset therefore cannot be treated as a verified G6 Tools+Iteration run.
issues.remediation: Keep the historical G6 artifacts immutable. Freeze an explicit corrected G3 Tools+Iteration adapter, run it against the verified 23-family denominator with the same public inputs, matched G4 controls, hard limits, raw traces, and 2 workers; re-audit and use only the corrected handoff for G7.

verification.evidence: Corrected G6 protocol profile executed with exactly 2 workers on the verified 23-family denominator; final audit passes 552/552 plan/response/trace rows with no failures; independent release review structural_pass=true and corrected handoff is used by G7.
